text:
ana: Quick design note — ran into messy alignment on mini-tiles when legends change height. On 4-up the rows get uneven.
yusuf: Yep. The root cause is per-card legend wrapping. Suggest a fixed collapsed height so all cards align.
tori: For collapsed state I like a pill that reads `Series (N)` with a chevron. Click/Enter expands an overlay anchored to the card so we don’t push layout.
ben: Agreed. When expanded, focus must move into the overlay and Esc should close and return focus to the pill. Also keep overlay role=dialog but aria-modal=false.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: "pill has aria-expanded; accessible name includes count; overlay focuses first item; Esc returns focus; overlay announced as dialog (aria-label)".
ana: (typo) ana: microcopy thought: visible label = "Series (4)", sr-only label = "Expand series list, 4 items". Keep it short for compact tiles.
yusuf: Units on tiny tiles — use condensed suffixes (K, M). But show full number in an offscreen span referenced by aria-describedby so screen readers read the exact value.
tori: Also add an inline affordance: a tiny chevron/caret next to abbreviated numbers that opens a popover with raw value on click/keyboard. Popover must be reachable by Tab.
ben: Smoothing modes are confusing for PMs. Propose segmented control: "Contextual | Off | Resample". Tooltip: "Contextual smooths the line but keeps spike markers; Resample reduces points for performance".
yusuf: Good separation. Add a small help link: "When to disable contextual smoothing" that opens docs.
a11y-bot: Add aria notes: "segmented control uses role=listbox or toggle buttons and each option has aria-pressed/aria-checked; spike markers must be focusable and announced".
ana: (ana) outliers: prefer dim + marker vs clipping. When points are off-scale show a tiny caret on the axis edge labeled "off-scale". Hover/focus shows the original value and the reason (e.g., ">99.9th percentile").
tori: UX for the caregiver: show a badge on the pill when dimming is active: "Outlier dimming"; clicking it opens the policy modal (slider + histogram preview + small sparkline).
yusuf: Histogram preview is great. When sliding thresholds the sparkline should show before/after so folks understand impact. Keep this lightweight — precompute histograms server-side for the current time window to avoid heavy client work.
ben: Dev constraint: canvas renderer — avoid per-point DOM updates. Use one-pass draw with a shader uniform for band alpha and a small mask texture to mark dimmed points. We'll coordinate with eng-runtime.
a11y-bot: Announcements examples: "data point dimmed by auto-scale, value 1,234,567, percentile 99.9" and "series list, 4 items, collapsed". Keep messages concise and consistent.
ana: (ana) microcopy for band explanation: "Typical range (10th90th percentile)." For tooltips prefer "Typical range — 10th90th pct" to fit small popovers.
tori: Keyboard flow: Tab -> pill -> Enter expands -> focus to first legend entry -> Arrow keys navigate series -> Enter toggles visibility -> Esc closes. Document in interaction spec.
yusuf: Small-multiples layout: when legend collapsed use fixed height (e.g., 32px) and align chart tops. Expanded overlays float above. Also add a subtle gradient fade on long legend lists with "Show more" link for large sets.
ben: Performance note: alpha for band fills should be applied in shader via uniform. Per-series dropout via mask texture. Avoid reading per-point attributes in JS for every frame. I'll file infra ticket with a tiny shader snippet.
a11y-bot: Final checklist item: "focus rings meet 4.5:1 contrast on both pill and close button; popovers are keyboard accessible; screen reader announcements include raw numbers for abbreviated values".
ana: Action items: 1) Tori to draft pill/overlay microcopy + keyboard spec. 2) Yusuf to mock histogram + sparkline preview and server-side histogram plan. 3) Ben to open infra ticket with shader mask idea. 4) A11y-bot will publish the checklist and example announcements.
tori: I'll post Figma frames and copy variants in #design today.
yusuf: I'll sketch server-side histogram shape and a tiny API contract for preview.
ben: I'll attach a perf estimate and shader example to the ticket.
a11y-bot: I'll add a short QA script for keyboard + screen reader checks.
nana: Thanks! Hoping to batch this into next sprint. :thumbsup:
